pdf1.question: The picture shows several children sitting on a carnival ride. During one part of the ride, the children in their seats are dropped from a certain height. pdf1.explanation: Gravity always acts downwards (U). Friction opposes motion. Since the children are dropped downwards, friction acts upwards (S).
